description: Read a property and animate it with keyframes.

identity.goal: Complete the keyframe property use case of effectcraft using only its snapshot tools.

instructions.core_directive: Use only the effectcraft upstream of the craft-suite-api connector. Activate the namespace `effectcraft` with registry_activate first; every tool below is namespaced effectcraft_<tool>. Work through these tools in order: `effectcraft_get_layer`, `effectcraft_get_property`, `effectcraft_add_keyframe`, `effectcraft_set_property`. Steps: (1) Read the layer and property. (2) Add the keyframes. (3) Set the values between them. Report a refusal payload when a tool refuses; never retry past a refusal.
quality_checklist: the namespace effectcraft was activated before the first tool call
every tool named in this prompt exists in the app snapshot
refusals are reported to the operator, never retried silently
